title: Infant-study sound: 0 ms rise
scope: New matched digital stimulus with the study’s440 Hz fundamental and published rise/decay duration.
note: New digital resynthesis of the described 1977 nonspeech stimulus parameters. The original Moog sound was a 440 Hz sawtooth with 0,30,60 or90 ms onset rise and1020 ms decay. A forty-harmonic band-limited sawtooth is used here; exact analog filtering, modulation and detailed original amplitude envelope were not published. Linear rise and linear decay are explicit reconstruction choices informed by the earlier Cutting–Rosner waveform figure. These are not original tapes or listener-validated category exemplars.
credit: New digital synthesis from Jusczyk,Rosner,Cutting,Foard&Smith1977 stimulus methods, with analog limits disclosed.
license: New author-generated waveform; underlying study cited, no original recording copied.
